creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers tax preparation, financial products and small-business financial services, with no creative activity.

community.reason: Level 2: the Human Capital section describes only employee development (tax professional training), so the employee-development cap of 2 applies; no external education or community investment is described.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: associate-led Belonging Groups are a specific current internal practice, but no membership or other figures are disclosed.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 2: Wave is specific current small-business software and payment tooling (enabling), but no users, customers or revenue are disclosed, so torn between 2 and 3 resolves to the lower level.

evidence.activity: Annual tax training and extra education for the company's own tax professionals
evidence.quote: H&R Block tax professionals receive extensive annual tax training on topics including recent tax code changes and filing practices, and we offer additional education opportunities for tax professionals to enhance their knowledge and skills.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital > Training and Development

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: Employee-led affinity networks (Belonging Groups) open to all associates
evidence.quote: One of the many ways we foster this culture across the organization for all associates to connect, support, motivate, and inspire is through our associate-led Belonging Groups.

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: employee networks with no figures

evidence.activity: Wave online finance software for small business owners, covering payment processing, payroll and bookkeeping
evidence.quote: Wave® provides small business owners with an online solution to manage their finances, including payment processing, payroll and bookkeeping services.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Other Offerings > Small Business Financial Solutions

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 2: specific current small-business software and payment tool, reach not quantified

evidence.activity: Block Advisors paid tax, bookkeeping and payroll services for small businesses through the office network
evidence.quote: Our Block Advisors® small business certified tax professionals provide small businesses with financial expertise in taxes, bookkeeping and payroll through our office network (including in-person, online and virtual).
evidence.section: Item 1 > Other Offerings > Small Business Financial Solutions

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 1: paid professional services to small-business customers

notes: Single reported segment, and no small-business revenue, user or customer counts are disclosed. The MD&A mentions only that 'small business payments transaction fees' grew, inside a combined $6.4 million figure that also includes credit card fees, so it was not used as an indicator. Franchising is described as a way for H&R Block to expand its own presence, not as a founder-enabling program, so it was not scored. Refund Transfers are 'frequently obtained' by clients without bank accounts, but they are described as a refund-disbursement and fee-payment feature, not a service built for underserved customers, so they were not counted for Cross-cultural. The Purpose and 'communities' language is general and did not raise Community. The 'equitable and comprehensive benefits' language is general, apart from seasonal-worker medical eligibility, which is required by the ACA.
